title: Seller's Transfer Disclosure Statement (TDS)
description: California Civil Code §1102 requires sellers of 1-4 residential units to complete a Transfer Disclosure Statement. Buyer has 3 days (personal delivery) or 5 days (mail) to rescind after receipt.

required_actions.note: Buyer has 3 days (hand delivery) or 5 days (mail) to rescind after receipt.

title: Natural Hazard Disclosure (NHD)
description: California law requires sellers to disclose whether the property is in special flood, fire, earthquake, seismic, landslide, or other natural hazard zones.

required_actions.note: NHD report prepared by a third-party disclosure company (~$100-150).

title: Agent Visual Inspection Disclosure (AVID)
description: Listing and buyer's agent must each conduct a visual inspection of the property and disclose all material facts on the AVID form.

title: Dual Agency Disclosure and Consent
description: California requires written disclosure and consent of both buyer and seller when a single brokerage represents both parties.

title: FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area Disclosure
description: If property is in a FEMA SFHA, seller must disclose. Lenders require flood insurance for SFHA properties with federally-backed loans.

required_actions.note: Included in NHD report. Verify flood insurance requirement with lender.

title: HOA Documents Disclosure Package
description: Sellers of properties within a common interest development must provide buyer a full set of HOA documents under Civil Code §4525.

required_actions.note: Package must include CC&Rs, bylaws, budget, reserve study, pending assessments (Civil Code §4525).

title: Mello-Roos / Special Assessment Disclosure
description: Sellers must disclose any Mello-Roos Community Facility District levies or special assessments via a Notice of Special Tax.

title: Military Ordnance Location Disclosure
description: If property is within one mile of a former federal or state ordnance location, seller must disclose.
